item.title: Comment on C-sections: A crash course by Dr. Michael Collins
item.description: I agree with Karina's comments. As a UK trained doctor I found it amazing how many C-Section deliveries there were in North America (USA and Canada) compared to the UK. On working there I discovered the reason - the doctors were not experienced in operative vaginal deliveries. I discuss this at length in my new book - Pregnancy for beginners.
